Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency. 
In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value. 
In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.
Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing. Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%. 
Now to More Personal Computing. Revenue was $12.9 billion and declined 4% and 5% in constant currency.
Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices.
Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships.
And in XBOX, revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance.
Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition. Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency drive

# 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

## 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：`press_release.txt` 位置 18895 的分部收入表）：

| 期间 | Intelligent Cloud 收入 |
|------|----------------------|
| Q4 FY26（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日） | $39,306 百万 |
| Q4 FY25（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日） | $29,878 百万 |

**计算过程**：
- 同比增长额 = $39,306M − $29,878M = **$9,428M**
- 同比增长率 = $9,428M ÷ $29,878M = **31.55%**，四舍五入为 **32%**（GAAP）
- 恒定汇率增长 = **31%**（汇率正向影响 $80M）

（来源：`metrics.txt` 同样确认 Azure 增长 43%，与分部 32% 增长一致）

---

## 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

来源：`transcript.txt` 位置 24808–27500（Amy Hood 的分部回顾段落）

**Azure 增长 43% 的归因**：
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

**On-premises server 业务（基本持平）的归因**：
> "Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

**分部整体毛利率**：
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

---

## 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

### ✅ 已发生的事实（回顾季度实际表现）

| 归因 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| Azure 收入增长 43% | `press_release.txt` 位置 3115 明确列示 |
| 客户需求超过可用产能 | `transcript.txt` 24808："Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"（描述 Q4 季度内状态） |
| CPU/GPU 效率提升和流程改进使新产能提前交付 | 同上："Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains...process improvements to enable earlier delivery"（对已实现增长的归因） |
| 季度内新增 Azure 产能被快速变现 | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized"（"in-quarter"明确指 Q4 内） |
| GitHub Copilot 6 月业务模式变更后消费强于预期 | "following the June business model change...stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption"（已发生的变更和已实现的消费） |
| On-premises server 续约合同结构带来更高的期内收入确认 | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"（已实现的 Q4 结果） |

### 🔮 前瞻性表述（管理层对未来的判断/指引）

| 表述 | 位置 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | `transcript.txt` 32535 附近（outlook 段落） | "remain focused"、"bridge the gaps we see" 是面向未来的承诺/判断 |
| "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | 同上 | 明确的前瞻预期 |
| FY27 Q1 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引 $40.95–$41.25B（增长 33%–34%） | 同上 | "we expect revenue of..." |
| FY27 Q1 Azure 恒定汇率增长约 45% | 同上 | "we expect revenue growth of approximately 45%" |
| "we are focused on delivering efficiencies"（对 Q1 Azure 指引的支撑） | 同上 | 前瞻性动作承诺 |

**区分依据**：
- **时态与语境**：回顾段落使用过去时/完成态（"grew"、"was"、"benefited"），描述已实现的 Q4 结果；outlook 段落使用将来时/预期态（"we expect"、"we continue to expect"、"we remain focused"）。
- **"continues" 一词的双重性**：回顾段落的 "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" 描述的是 Q4 季度内持续存在的状态，属事实；outlook 段落的同名表述则被用作支撑未来指引的判断依据。
- **具体数字**：32% 是已报告的实际数字；33%–34% 和 45% 是明确标注为 "expect" 的未来指引。
